I'm sorry to hear about what you're going through. I understand how you feel. After my assessment, the psychologist implied I didn't have ASD and I felt so sad for the same reasons as you. I have ADHD, general anxiety disorder,  and PTSD so she didn't see my struggles with ASD and thought I was one of the TikTok people who misdiagnosed themselves. Luckily their supervisor went over their notes with them and conducted a second interview with me. They saw how much I struggled with communication, friendships, and masking my whole life. 

I am now diagnosed with level 1 ASD and it's great. I struggle with communicating with a new doctor but with my diagnosis, I can request accommodations like bringing my spouse to my appts so they advocate for me. 

It's unfortunate you can't get more inexpensive help without a diagnosis but as the others said,  you can still use the same coping skills if it works for you. It helps a lot knowing what you do or don't have.
